articles.description: 吴说获悉，Utah 州众议院通过 HB0230S03 法案，并同意参议院修正案。该法案删除了授权州财政主管投资数字资产、进行质押和借贷的条款，并取消了对稳定币投资的监管豁免。同时，明确禁止州和地方政府限制数字资产的接受与托管，维持资金传输许可豁免，保障个人和企业运行区块链节点、开发软件、转移数字资产及参与质押的权利。此外，法案继续限制地方政府对工业区内数字资产挖矿的噪音管控和分区限制，不涉及资金拨款。 http://wublock123.com/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=show&catid=6&id=39146

articles.description:
RT Eric Wall | BIP-420 🐱
If you want to understand what happens to funds after they’re stolen by North Korea/Lazarus Group, the Chainalysis 2022 report is great
Step 1: Swap any ERC20s (like stETH) into ETH 
Step 2: Swap any ETH into BTC 
Step 3: Cash out BTC to cash (Chinese Renminbi) using Asian exchanges 
This process can take years. They are in no hurry. 
In 2022, it was noted how North Korea was still sitting on $55 worth of funds from hacks that happened six years earlier (2016).

RT goodalexander
There’s this concept that took me forever to learn 
A lot of the best traders are poker players or sports betting enthusiasts. They’re focused on maximizing their statistical edge. And they love franchises that allow them to “pursue their art”. They’re gamers 
If you’re running a franchise - you want to fill it with people like this. 
The people who tend to look at the world this way think they’re “playing the greatest game ever invented”. They’re pricing assets - they need to. If they didn’t capitalism wouldn’t work. They get to experience the joy of “making the markets efficient”
